cards.title: Meet Riff+
cards.body: Everything in Riff, plus Automix, the app equalizer and Stats for nerds. Both editions are free.

cards.title: Sing
cards.body: Remove the vocals from a song, right on the phone. Find it under Playback tools in the player's menu.

cards.title: Blend with a friend
cards.body: Scan each other's QR code and both get one playlist from your 100 most-played songs. Library → Phone playlists.

cards.title: Your headphones, tuned
cards.body: Pick your headphones from thousands of AutoEq profiles, and change a song's key, on the Equalizer screen.

cards.title: Mixes made from Encore
cards.body: On repeat, Time of day, Heating up and more on Home, built on the phone from what you play.
